entries.brief: Use case: stylized-concept. One original square painterly fantasy spell icon for SKAZ D&D 2014, broad sculpted painted forms, crisp dark defining edges, warm highlights, readable at 32px on ivory and charcoal. Central 70% of canvas with generous transparent margins. True transparent background. No text, lettering, runes, borders, watermark, scenery, floor, tiny particles, diffuse bloom. A compact fan of five broad luminous rainbow ribbons bursting from a small cupped gloved hand, saturated red gold green cyan violet, strong arc silhouette. One hand only, no stars, no text or eye.
